snippet.title: GreedFall: The Dying World | Preorder Trailer
snippet.description:
GreedFall: The Dying World is now available for pre-order on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PS5!
 
Explore Gacane and plunge into a thrilling story filled with twists and turns at every corner. The future of two worlds sits in your hands. How will you handle it? The choice is yours.
 
Pre-purchase now and unlock the Gacane Pioneer's pack at launch.
